name: Cavendish Square
paymentPlan: 20% down payment at sales launch; 40% during construction; 40% on handover
overview: Cavendish Square, a prestigious new residential complex created by LEOS International, is located in Dubai's Jumeirah Village Triangle. This new building boasts painstakingly constructed studio and one-bedroom apartments with unrivaled features and services to assure a luxury lifestyle. Cavendish Square's strategic position provides great connectivity, making it one of Dubai's most sought-after sites.
